description: Defines the NetworkErrorLoggingService class and related data structures for handling network error logging, policies, and reports within the Chromium project.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService
classes.description: Main class for managing network error logging policies, reports, and persistent storage.

classes.name: PersistentNelStore
classes.description: Interface for persistent storage of NEL policies.

classes.name: NelPolicyKey
classes.description: Represents a unique key for a NEL policy based on (NIK, origin).

classes.name: WildcardNelPolicyKey
classes.description: Represents a wildcard key for policies applicable to a domain and its subdomains.

classes.name: NelPolicy
classes.description: Stores details of a NEL policy, including expiration, report endpoint, and fractions.

classes.name: RequestDetails
classes.description: Contains details of a network error request for reporting.

classes.name: SignedExchangeReportDetails
classes.description: Contains details of a signed exchange report.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a NetworkErrorLoggingService instance with optional persistent store.

methods.name: SetReportingService
methods.description: Assigns a ReportingService to queue reports.

methods.name: OnHeader
methods.description: Processes a received NEL header for a given (NIK, origin).

methods.name: OnRequest
methods.description: Handles a network error request for reporting.

methods.name: RemoveBrowsingData
methods.description: Removes policies associated with origins matching a filter.

methods.name: StatusAsValue
methods.description: Returns a Value representing current policies for debugging.

methods.name: GetPolicyKeysForTesting
methods.description: Returns current policy keys for testing.
